## § flow-owner-commit

## Playbook: owner-commit
Use when: create items, or edit item, roadmap or capability text, in one owner commit

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user, or skill lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace?" |
| order | the owner's message, quoted verbatim: the speaker says they are the workspace owner ("I am the workspace owner", "sou o dono") and orders these changes | STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap.md`. Say: "There is no owner order, so I can only propose this change; nothing was changed." |
| changes | the order, one line per change: create item (roadmap, title, description, category, priority), edit item (item, new title/description/category/priority), edit roadmap (title/description), edit capability (name/description) | STOP. Say: "Which changes exactly?" |
| rationale | the owner's reason, verbatim (after "Rationale:", "Motivo:", "porque", "because"), 10–2000 characters | STOP. Say: "What is the reason for these changes? It is stored with the commit." |
| commitSaid | "yes" when the order says commit, apply, "do it", "pode aplicar" for these changes; else "no" | "no" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was committed."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   Always make this call, even when the order says "commit".
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode, else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"
2. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","compact":true} [A]
   SAVE: ids = for each named roadmap, item and capability: the id and updatedAt of the one roadmaps[], items[] or capabilities[] entry whose title (capability: name) or id equals it, plus the item's lifecycle and isArchived
   IF a name matches 0 or 2+ entries → STOP. Say: "Which one do you mean: <the matching titles with ids>?"
   IF an edited item has lifecycle "materialized" → STOP. Say: "<item> is materialized and locked for edits. Archive it, or add a follow-up item?"
   IF an edited item has isArchived true → STOP. Say: "<item> is archived. Restore it first (playbook items, change restore)."
3. IF <saved:mode> == "enforce" and a change edits an item → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap.md`. Say: "<input:workspaceId> is in enforce: item edits go through a change request (changeType edit or prioritize). Nothing was changed."
   IF <input:changes> has a dependency or an allocation → STOP. Say: "Dependencies and allocations use playbook dependency or allocation. Nothing was changed."
4. SAVE: operations = a JSON array, one object per change, built only from these templates (key "type", never "op"; changed fields only inside "patch" or "values"; leave out a field the order does not give):
   ```text
   {"type":"create_item","roadmapId":"<roadmap id>","values":{"title":"<title>","description":"<text>","category":"<text>","priority":"urgent|high|medium|low|none"}}
   {"type":"update_item","itemId":"<item id>","expectedVersion":"<item updatedAt>","patch":{"title":"<new title>","priority":"<new priority>"}}
   {"type":"update_roadmap","roadmapId":"<roadmap id>","expectedVersion":"<roadmap updatedAt>","patch":{"title":"<new title>","description":"<text>"}}
   {"type":"update_capability","capabilityId":"<capability id>","expectedVersion":"<capability updatedAt>","patch":{"name":"<new name>","description":"<text>"}}
   ```
   IF <saved:operations> has more than 20 objects → STOP. Say: "One commit holds at most 20 changes. Which 20 first?"
5. CALL `preview_owner_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","rationale":"<input:rationale>","operations":"<saved:operations>"} [A] (send operations as the JSON array, not as a string)
   SAVE: previewId = result.id; digest = result.digest; previewRationale = result.rationale
   IF result.operations differ from <saved:operations> (a text cut, a priority dropped) → STOP. Say: "LPM changed the request: <difference>. Nothing was committed; correct the values and run again."
6. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: commit these <n> roadmap changes directly (preview <saved:previewId>)? It skips change-request review. Reply as the workspace owner."
   IF <input:commitSaid> == "no" → ASK: "Commit these <n> operations now (preview <saved:previewId>, digest <saved:digest>)? It skips change-request review. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
7. CALL `commit_owner_roadmap_change` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","previewId":"<saved:previewId>","previewDigest":"<saved:digest>","rationale":"<saved:previewRationale>","idempotencyKey":"owner-commit-<saved:previewId>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Commit failed: <error text>. Nothing was committed. After a timeout run this step again with the same idempotencyKey; after 'expired' or 'changed' run this playbook again."
   SAVE: commitId = result.commitId; affected = result.affectedEntityIds (one id per operation, in order; a create_item gives the new item id; never the preview's ids)
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an id of <saved:affected> is missing from items[], roadmaps[] and capabilities[] or shows other values than the preview → STOP. Say: "Commit <saved:commitId> ran, but the re-read does not show <id> with the previewed values."
   SAVE: readBack = each id of <saved:affected> with the values read; newItems = the ids at create_item positions

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> (mode <saved:mode>); owner order: "<input:order>"
Done: <commit_owner_roadmap_change <saved:commitId> (preview <saved:previewId>, digest <saved:digest>): each id of <saved:affected> with its new values | nothing committed>; <in enforce: "LPM has no change request that creates an item or edits roadmap or capability text, so this owner commit is the path, run on your order" | nothing>
Evidence: <get_workspace_roadmap_overview: <saved:readBack> | none>
Pending: <none | the changes left out and why>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | new items <saved:newItems> are draft: their next gate is reviewed (playbook lifecycle, needs your order) | none>
```
mode: off | shadow | enforce, from step 1. A created item is always lifecycle draft. Never claim a change that the VERIFY in step 7 did not show.

## Playbook: lifecycle

| target | the gate in the order: "reviewed", "approved" ("aprovar"), "deferred", "rejected", "delivered" ("entregue") or "closed" | STOP. Say: "Which gate: reviewed, approved, deferred, rejected, delivered or closed?" |

   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode, else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"
   IF <saved:mode> == "enforce" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap.md`. Say: "<input:workspaceId> is in enforce: lifecycle gates go through a change request (changeType lifecycle). Nothing was changed."
2. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","compact":true,"includeArchived":true} [A]
   SAVE: roadmapId = id of the one roadmaps[] entry whose title or id equals <input:roadmap>; itemId, lifecycle, isArchived = those fields of the one items[] entry with roadmapId == <saved:roadmapId> whose title or id equals <input:item>; was = <saved:lifecycle>

SAVE: gates = [<input:target>] when this move is allowed: draft or imported → reviewed, deferred, rejected; reviewed → approved, deferred, rejected; approved → deferred; deferred or rejected → reviewed; materialized → delivered; delivered → closed. How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user, or skill lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace?" |
| order | the owner's message, quoted verbatim: the speaker says they are the workspace owner and orders this change | STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap.md`. Say: "There is no owner order, so I can only propose this as a change request; nothing was changed." |

| project | the project name, key or id | STOP. Say: "Which project?" |
| change | "create", "edit" (role or rationale) or "archive" | STOP. Say: "Allocate, change or remove the allocation?" |
| role | primary, contributor, dependent or observer, from the order | create: STOP. Say: "Which role: primary, contributor, dependent or observer?"; else "unchanged" |
| rationale | the owner's reason, verbatim ("Motivo:", "porque"); an archive stores it as the rationale | the quoted order |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was changed."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode, else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"
2. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","compact":true,"includeArchived":true} [A]
   SAVE: roadmapId = id of the one roadmaps[] entry whose title or id equals <input:roadmap>; itemId, isArchived = those fields of the one items[] entry with roadmapId == <saved:roadmapId> whose title or id equals <input:item>; allocs = allocations[] entries with itemId == <saved:itemId> (id, projectId, role, status)
   IF a name matches 0 or 2+ entries → STOP. Say: "Which one do you mean: <the matching titles with ids>?"
3. CALL `list_workspace_projects` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: projectId = id of the one project whose name, key or id equals <input:project>
   IF 0 or 2+ projects match → STOP. Say: "Which project: <the matching names with ids>?"
   SAVE: allocId, allocRole = id, role of the <saved:allocs> entry with projectId == <saved:projectId> and status "active" or no status, empty if none; primaryId = id of the <saved:allocs> entry with role "primary" and status "active" or no status, empty if none
4. IF <input:change> == "create" and <saved:allocRole> == <input:role> → SAVE: readBack = "already active: <saved:allocId>"; go to Answer.
   IF <input:change> == "create" and <saved:isArchived> == true → STOP. Say: "<input:item> is archived; restore it first (playbook items)."
   IF <input:change> != "create" and <saved:allocId> is empty → STOP. Say: "<input:project> has no active allocation on <input:item>."
   IF <input:change> == "edit" and <input:role> == "primary" → STOP. Say: "Making a role primary here can leave two primaries. Use change create with role primary: it replaces the current primary."
   IF <saved:mode> == "enforce" and <input:change> == "create" → STOP. This belongs to skill `lpm-roadmap.md`. Say: "In enforce a new allocation is a change request (changeType allocate). Nothing was changed."
   SAVE: newRole = <input:role>, else <saved:allocRole> when "unchanged"; newStatus = "archived" for archive, else "active"; replaces = <saved:primaryId> when <input:change> == "create" and <input:role> == "primary", else ""
5. IF <saved:mode> == "enforce" → switch to playbook governance.
   Hand it mode "window", kind "allocation", entityId <saved:allocId>, newValue <saved:newRole>, newStatus <saved:newStatus>, rationale <input:rationale>.
   IF <input:change> != "create" → go to step 8.
6. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: allocate <input:project> as <saved:newRole> on <input:item>?"

   SAVE: readBack = "<saved:allocId> <saved:newRole> <saved:newStatus>"

```text

Done: <allocation <saved:allocId>: role <saved:newRole>, status <saved:newStatus>; replaced <saved:replaces> | nothing changed>
```

## § flow-import

## Playbook: import
Use when: import a TSV file of roadmap items

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user, or skill lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace?" |
| order | the owner's message, quoted verbatim: the speaker says they are the workspace owner and orders this import | STOP. Say: "Importing a roadmap is the workspace owner's decision. Nothing was imported." |
| content | the TSV text the owner gave: TAB-separated, first line = headers, one item per row, a title column (title, titulo, name, nome, funcionalidade) | STOP. Say: "Send the file as TAB-separated text with a title column." |
| sourceRef | the file name the owner gave | "pasted.tsv" |
| roadmap | the existing roadmap title or id to import into, or "new" | "new" |
| title | the new roadmap's title from the order | <input:sourceRef> |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing was imported."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: mode = result.roadmapGovernanceMode, else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"
2. CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","compact":true,"includeArchived":true} [A]
   Always make this call: it also catches a lost earlier import.
   SAVE: roadmapId = "" when <input:roadmap> == "new", else the id of the one roadmaps[] entry whose title or id equals <input:roadmap>
   IF <input:roadmap> != "new" and 0 or 2+ entries match → STOP. Say: "Which roadmap: <the matching titles with ids>?"
   IF <input:roadmap> == "new" and a roadmaps[] entry has sourceRef == <input:sourceRef> → STOP. Say: "Roadmap <id> already came from <input:sourceRef> (one import is one batch). Import into it again (existing rows are skipped) or use another file name?"
3. CALL `preview_workspace_roadmap_import` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","content":"<input:content>","sourceRef":"<input:sourceRef>"} [A]
   SAVE: rowCount = result.rowCount; warnings = result.warnings; summary = each row's title, priority and dependsOn
   IF <saved:rowCount> == 0 → STOP. Say: "The file has no importable rows: it must be TAB-separated with a header row that has a title column. Convert CSV to TSV and send it again. Nothing was imported."
   SAVE: target = "roadmap <saved:roadmapId>" when <saved:roadmapId> is not empty, else "a new draft roadmap '<input:title>'"; note = in enforce: "LPM has no change request that imports items and does not block an import; this direct import runs on your order", else ""
4. ASK: "Import <saved:rowCount> rows into <saved:target>? Warnings: <saved:warnings>. Rows: <saved:summary> (a 'blocks' column is read as 'depends on'). Items start as imported. <saved:note> (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
5. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: import <saved:rowCount> rows into <saved:target>?"
6. CALL `commit_workspace_roadmap_import` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","content":"<input:content>","sourceRef":"<input:sourceRef>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","title":"<input:title>","confirmed":true} [O] (content and sourceRef exactly as in step 3; roadmapId "" makes a new roadmap)
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Import failed: <error text>. Do not retry blindly: run this playbook again; step 2 finds a roadmap that this import created."
   SAVE: newRoadmapId = result.roadmapId; created = result.createdItemIds; importedRows = result.importedRows (rows read, not rows created)
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_items` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:newRoadmapId>","compact":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an id of <saved:created> is not listed → STOP. Say: "Imported into <saved:newRoadmapId>, but item <id> is not listed."
   SAVE: listed = the number of items listed; skipped = <saved:importedRows> minus the count of <saved:created> (rows already in that roadmap)

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:newRoadmapId> (mode <saved:mode>); owner order: "<input:order>"
Done: <commit_workspace_roadmap_import: <the count of <saved:created>> items created as imported, <saved:skipped> rows skipped | nothing imported>; <saved:note>
Evidence: <list_workspace_roadmap_items <saved:newRoadmapId>: <saved:listed> items, every created id listed | none>
Pending: <none | warnings <saved:warnings>>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | playbook import-links for <saved:newRoadmapId>: dependency column and project allocations (needs your order)>
```
Imported items start with lifecycle imported; approving one takes two gates (reviewed, then approved). Never claim an item count that the VERIFY in step 6 did not show.

   IF an entry has idempotencyKey == <saved:key> → SAVE: matId = that id; reqId = its requirementId; state = "already recorded"; go to Answer.
   IF <saved:method> is linked_existing, new_requirement or split_from_parent and an entry with itemId == <saved:itemId> has one of those methods → STOP. Say: "<input:item> already has productive materialization <id> (<method>) in <input:project>; LPM allows one. Nothing was changed."
7. ASK: "Record the materialization of <input:item> in <input:project>: method <saved:method>, requirement <saved:requirementId or 'new'>, baseline <saved:baselineId>? This is permanent: no tool undoes it.<in enforce: ' Enforce does not apply here; the materialize change request writes nothing.'> (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
8. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: materialize <input:item> in <input:project> (method <saved:method>)? It is permanent."
9. CALL `commit_roadmap_materialization` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","itemId":"<saved:itemId>","projectId":"<saved:projectId>","method":"<saved:method>","requirementId":"<saved:requirementId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>","rationale":"<input:rationale>","confirmed":true,"idempotencyKey":"<saved:key>","sourceItemVersion":"<saved:sourceVersion>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<error text>. Nothing was materialized. After a timeout or 'Roadmap item changed after preview' run this playbook again (same date: same key)."
   SAVE: matId = result.id; reqId = result.requirementId; state = result.materializationSummary.state
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_materializations` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","roadmapId":"<saved:roadmapId>","projectId":"<saved:projectId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or no entry has id <saved:matId> and method <saved:method> → STOP. Say: "Materialization <saved:matId> is not listed."
   VERIFY: CALL `list_requirements` {"projectId":"<saved:projectId>","baselineId":"<saved:baselineId>"} [A] (only for new_requirement or split_from_parent)
   IF the call returns an error or <saved:reqId> is not listed → STOP. Say: "Requirement <saved:reqId> is not listed in baseline <saved:baselineId>."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <saved:roadmapId> / <saved:itemId> → <saved:projectId> (mode <saved:mode>); owner order: "<input:order>"
Done: <materialization <saved:matId>: method <saved:method>, requirement <saved:reqId>, baseline <saved:baselineId>; summary <saved:state> | nothing materialized>
Evidence: <list_workspace_roadmap_materializations lists <saved:matId>; list_requirements lists <saved:reqId> | none>
Pending: <none | other allocated projects: one run each>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | new requirement <saved:reqId> is pending: skill lpm-requirements-scope (working scope, baseline) | none>
```
summary state: unmaterialized | partial | complete | attention. The item keeps lifecycle approved; no activities are created. Never claim a materialization that a VERIFY above did not show.


## § flow-governance

## Playbook: governance
Use when: change the governance mode, or run the enforce window the owner chose

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user, or skill lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace?" |
| order | the owner's message, quoted verbatim: the speaker says they are the workspace owner and orders this | STOP. Say: "This is the workspace owner's decision." |
| mode | "off", "shadow" or "enforce" named in the order ("pode fazer direto" is none); "window" when playbook dependency or allocation switched here or the owner replied "A" below | STOP. Say: "Which mode: off, shadow or enforce?" |
| kind | window: "dependency" or "allocation" | "none" |
| entityId | window: the linkId or allocationId saved there | "none" |
| newValue | window: the type or role saved there | "none" |
| newStatus | window: the status saved there | "none" |
| rationale | the owner's reason, verbatim | the quoted order |
| pick | "A" only when the owner replied "A" to the decision request | "none" |
| stamp | the current UTC date and time, yyyymmddHHMM | STOP. Say: "Current UTC time (yyyymmddHHMM)?" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>."
1. CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: before = result.roadmapGovernanceMode, else "off" when result.roadmapGovernanceEnabled == false, else "shadow"; after = <saved:before>; wsUpdatedAt = result.updatedAt; threshold = result.roadmapGovernancePolicy.soloMaterialAlertThreshold, else 5; failed = ""; readBack = "none"; openMode = "shadow" when <input:mode> == "window", else <input:mode>
   IF <input:mode> == "window" and <saved:before> != "enforce" → STOP. Say: "Mode is <saved:before>: run playbook <input:kind> again."
   IF <input:mode> != "window" and <saved:before> == <input:mode> → go to Answer.
   IF <input:mode> != "window" → go to step 3.
2. SAVE: decision = this text, filled:
   ```text
   Decision needed: set <input:kind> <input:entityId> to <input:newValue>, status <input:newStatus>.
   Context: enforce; LPM blocks this write (GOVERNANCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED) and has no change-request type for it.
   Options: A) shadow, this write, enforce, in one run - a short window without review; reversible. B) wait for an LPM fix - no change. C) do nothing - no change.
   Recommendation: A, as your order names this operation.
   To proceed, reply "A" and I will run: update_workspace_roadmap_governance_policy(mode=shadow, expectedUpdatedAt=<saved:wsUpdatedAt>) → update_workspace_roadmap_<input:kind>(<input:entityId>, <input:newValue>, status=<input:newStatus>, rationale='<input:rationale>') → update_workspace_roadmap_governance_policy(mode=enforce), each with a new idempotencyKey
   ```
   IF <input:pick> != "A" → STOP. Say: "<saved:decision>"
3. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: mode <saved:before> → <saved:openMode>?"
4. CALL `update_workspace_roadmap_governance_policy` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","mode":"<saved:openMode>","expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:wsUpdatedAt>","soloMaterialAlertThreshold":"<saved:threshold>","idempotencyKey":"gov-<saved:openMode>-<input:workspaceId>-<input:stamp>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "Mode not changed: <error text>."
   IF result.mode != <saved:openMode> → STOP. Say: "LPM replayed an old run of this key; give me a new time stamp."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.roadmapGovernanceMode != <saved:openMode> → STOP. Say: "Mode reads <result.roadmapGovernanceMode>; nothing else ran."
   SAVE: after = <saved:openMode>; openedAt = result.updatedAt
   IF <input:mode> != "window" → go to Answer.
   IF <input:kind> == "dependency" → go to step 7.
5. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:decision>"
6. CALL `update_workspace_roadmap_allocation` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","allocationId":"<input:entityId>","role":"<input:newValue>","status":"<input:newStatus>","rationale":"<input:rationale>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: failed = "<error text>"; go to step 9.
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","compact":true,"includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or allocations[] entry <input:entityId> has status != <input:newStatus> → SAVE: failed = "re-read differs"; go to step 9.
   SAVE: readBack = "<input:entityId> <input:newStatus>"
   GO TO step 9
7. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "<saved:decision>"
8. CALL `update_workspace_roadmap_dependency` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","linkId":"<input:entityId>","type":"<input:newValue>","status":"<input:newStatus>","rationale":"<input:rationale>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → SAVE: failed = "<error text>"; go to step 9.
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace_roadmap_overview` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","compact":true,"includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or itemLinks[] entry <input:entityId> has status != <input:newStatus> → SAVE: failed = "re-read differs"; go to step 9.
   SAVE: readBack = "<input:entityId> <input:newStatus>"
9. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "URGENT: still in shadow. Reply yes to set enforce again."
   Always run this step after step 4.
10. CALL `update_workspace_roadmap_governance_policy` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","mode":"enforce","expectedUpdatedAt":"<saved:openedAt>","soloMaterialAlertThreshold":"<saved:threshold>","idempotencyKey":"gov-enforce-<input:workspaceId>-<input:stamp>"} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "URGENT: still in shadow: <error text>. Run this playbook with mode enforce."
   VERIFY: CALL `get_workspace` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.roadmapGovernanceMode != "enforce" → STOP. Say: "URGENT: mode reads <result.roadmapGovernanceMode>, not enforce."
   SAVE: after = "enforce"
   IF <saved:failed> is not empty → STOP. Say: "The write failed (<saved:failed>); the mode is back to enforce."

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> (mode <saved:before> → <saved:after>); owner order: "<input:order>"
Done: <mode <saved:before> → <saved:after> (threshold <saved:threshold> preserved) | window: shadow → <saved:readBack> → enforce | nothing changed>
Evidence: <get_workspace roadmapGovernanceMode <saved:after>; <saved:readBack> | none>
Pending: <none | owner decision | <saved:failed>>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | none>
```
mode: off | shadow | enforce, from your last get_workspace. Never claim what a VERIFY above did not show.


## § flow-migration

## Playbook: migration
Use when: apply or roll back a roadmap migration (governance or v2)

How to run this playbook:
- Follow steps in order. CALL sends the shown arguments; RUN executes a command. FOR EACH repeats its indented lines.
- Replace `<input:x>` from You need, `<saved:x>` from SAVE, `<each:x>` from the current item. Whole placeholders retain their JSON type, including numbers, arrays, objects and null; embedded ones are text. Never invent concurrency tokens. `result` is the last call's response.
- IF tests a condition; go to step N jumps forward; go to Answer ends execution.
- ASK waits for the user's answer unless that exact action is already authorized. STOP ends calls and puts its message in Next. Owner-only actions require the owner's order.
- VERIFY must pass before reporting success. Fill the Answer block in the user's language; copy IDs exactly. Secrets never enter the reply. **Your entire reply is ONLY the Answer block — no other text.**

### You need
| Input | Where it comes from | If missing |
|---|---|---|
| workspaceId | the user, or skill lpm-start | STOP. Say: "Which LPM workspace?" |
| order | the owner's message, quoted verbatim: the speaker says they are the workspace owner and orders this migration or rollback for this workspace | STOP. Say: "A migration is the workspace owner's decision. Nothing was changed." |
| action | "apply" (governance migration), "apply-v2" or "rollback" | STOP. Say: "Apply the governance migration, apply the v2 migration, or roll back a run?" |
| migrationId | for rollback: the apply's id (migration_ plus 32 hex) from the user or an earlier Answer | "none"; for rollback STOP. Say: "Which migration run (id migration_…)?" |
| stamp | the current UTC date and time, yyyymmddHHMM | STOP. Say: "What is the current UTC time (yyyymmddHHMM)?" |

### Steps
Every CALL with no error line: IF it returns an error → STOP. Say: "<tool> failed: <error text>. Nothing more was changed."
1. IF <input:action> == "apply-v2" → go to step 6.
   IF <input:action> == "rollback" → go to step 10.
2. CALL `preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: toSnapshot = result.roadmapItemsToSnapshot; toClassify = result.legacyIssuesToClassify
   IF <saved:toSnapshot> == 0 and <saved:toClassify> == 0 → STOP. Say: "Nothing to migrate: 0 items and 0 activities. Nothing was changed."
3. ASK: "Run apply_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, idempotencyKey=gov-migration-<input:workspaceId>-<input:stamp>, confirmed=true)? It stamps governanceVersion 1 on <saved:toSnapshot> items and workOrigin legacy-unknown on <saved:toClassify> activities (deleted ones too), in chunks of 400 with no global transaction. A rollback exists. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
4. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: apply the governance migration on <input:workspaceId>?"
5. CALL `apply_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","idempotencyKey":"gov-migration-<input:workspaceId>-<input:stamp>","confirmed":true} [O]
   IF the call returns an error → STOP. Say: "<error text>. After a timeout run this step again with the same stamp (same key); never a new key for this run."
   SAVE: runId = result.id; writes = result.appliedWrites
   VERIFY: CALL `preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or result.roadmapItemsToSnapshot != 0 or result.legacyIssuesToClassify != 0 → STOP. Say: "Run <saved:runId> wrote <saved:writes>, but the preview still shows <items> items and <activities> activities."
   SAVE: readBack = "preview 0 items, 0 activities"
   GO TO Answer
6. CALL `preview_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: valid = result.valid; v2mode = result.mode; legacyCount = result.legacyItemCount; rows = result.rows
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_items` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","compact":true,"includeArchived":true} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an itemId of <saved:rows> is not listed with lifecycle "materialized" → STOP. Say: "The v2 preview does not match the roadmap. Nothing was changed."
   IF <saved:legacyCount> == 0 or <saved:v2mode> == "no-op" → STOP. Say: "Nothing to migrate (v2). Nothing was changed."
   IF <saved:valid> != true → STOP. Say: "The v2 migration cannot run: <saved:rows>. It is written for exactly 10 legacy lineages. Nothing was changed."
7. ASK: "Run apply_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration(workspaceId=<input:workspaceId>, idempotencyKey=roadmap-v2-<input:workspaceId>-<input:stamp>, confirmed=true)? It rewrites <saved:legacyCount> legacy items, one transaction each, and has NO rollback: a failure midway leaves the rest unmigratable. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
8. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: apply the v2 migration on <input:workspaceId>? It cannot be undone."
9. CALL `apply_workspace_roadmap_v2_migration` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","idempotencyKey":"roadmap-v2-<input:workspaceId>-<input:stamp>","confirmed":true} [O]
   SAVE: runId = "v2"; writes = result.appliedItemIds
   VERIFY: CALL `list_workspace_roadmap_materializations` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or an entry of an item in <saved:writes> has no lineageState → STOP. Say: "The v2 apply returned <saved:writes>, but the materializations of <item> are not migrated."
   SAVE: readBack = "every materialization of <saved:writes> has a lineageState"
   GO TO Answer
10. CALL `preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   SAVE: beforeSum = result.roadmapItemsToSnapshot + result.legacyIssuesToClassify
11. ASK: "Roll back migration <input:migrationId> on <input:workspaceId>? It deletes workOrigin and roadmapLineageRefs from every activity that run stamped, also roadmap lineage added after the run. (yes/no)" — continue only if the user says yes; otherwise STOP.
12. ONLY IF the owner ordered it in this conversation (quote the order); otherwise STOP. Say: "Decision needed: roll back migration <input:migrationId>? Lineage added after it is lost."
13. CALL `rollback_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>","migrationId":"<input:migrationId>","idempotencyKey":"gov-rollback-<input:migrationId>","confirmed":true} [O]
   SAVE: runId = <input:migrationId>; writes = result.rolledBackWrites
   VERIFY: CALL `preview_workspace_roadmap_governance_migration` {"workspaceId":"<input:workspaceId>"} [A]
   IF the call returns an error or <saved:writes> == 0 → STOP. Say: "Run <input:migrationId> had nothing to undo, or the id is wrong. A new apply after a rollback needs a new stamp."
   SAVE: readBack = "preview sum <saved:beforeSum> before, <roadmapItemsToSnapshot + legacyIssuesToClassify> after (rises by at most <saved:writes>)"

### Answer (reply with exactly this block, filled in; write nothing before or after it)
```text
Scope: <input:workspaceId> / <input:action>; owner order: "<input:order>"
Done: <governance migration <saved:runId>: <saved:writes> writes | v2 migration: items <saved:writes> | rollback of <saved:runId>: <saved:writes> writes undone | preview only, nothing changed>
Evidence: <<saved:readBack> | none>
Pending: <none | the counts the re-read still shows>
Next: <the ASK or STOP text that ended the run | keep <saved:runId> for a rollback | none>
```
v2 preview mode: no-op | migration-required (after an apply it can stay migration-required; judge by legacyItemCount). Never claim a migration result that a VERIFY above did not show.
